**What this PR does / why we need it**:
This is a follow-up PR for https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/97823

This PR updates the gce-pd volume topology label to use GA version. Previously we were using beta label(FailureDomain) for the in-tree volumes. But as the Beta label has been deprecated for a while and is scheduled to be removed soon. We should update this to use GA label instead.

We intentionally didn't migrate to the stable labels and instead were going to use CSI migration to convert the beta labels to the csi labels because supporting GA labels would add extra complexity to csi migration. background: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/81431

However CSI migration timeline is likely to slip. We need to work with sig cloud provider to iron out the timelines. cc @andrewsykim @cheftako

Currently volume provisioners will still provision new PVs with beta labels in the NodeAffinity. At the time of implementation, we didn't want to change to v1 because not all nodes had v1 labels and it would add complexity to the csi migration translation layer to parse a nodeaffinity that had a (v1 or v1beta) rule.

But now that we can expect all nodes to have v1 topology on them, I think the translation logic should be simpler now, and we could revisit this decision. I think it particular, the current behavior where migrated pvs get provisioned with intree spec but csi topology label could potentially cause rollback issues.

cc @mattcary
Sorry I realize there's still a problem with old PVs created only with beta labels. Without csi migration, they will fail to schedule if nodes are created without beta labels.

One idea suggested by @thockin is to allow mutation of PV.NodeAffinity if the only change is to convert the beta label to GA label.

General mutation can lead to irrecoverable races in the scheduler: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/69528

Some digging process:

> We intentionally didn't migrate to the stable labels and instead were going to use CSI migration to convert the beta labels to the csi labels because supporting GA labels would add extra complexity to csi migration. background: #81431

To be specific, this comment: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/81431#discussion_r341216734

So IIUC we decide not to import any GA topology labels for in-tree volumes. Instead doing it in the csi migration translation process. And ideally after the CSI migration GA, all in-tree volume will start to use GA version node affinity. So the beta label is not a concern anymore.

Yes, however, we may want to reconsider that decision, mainly due to user confusion. Users may see their PVs getting created with deprecated beta labels, try to modify the labels themselves, and the csi migration library doesn't properly translate it.
